item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Clic-Clac
  • 発売日: 2009-08-15
  • スコア: 6.26/10 (11 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 田舎でシよう！ 北海道編 ～ボクと妹たちの夢日記～
  • 英語名: Inaka de Shiyou! Hokkaido Hen Boku to Imouto-tachi no Yume Nikki

あらすじ

Every year, as the end of December approaches, my sisters start bombarding me with emails begging me to come home.

But this year, something felt different.

When I arrived at the airport, there was Moyu, as lively as ever, and Yukihime, standing a step back with a shy, embarrassed smile.

item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Clic-Clac
  • 発売日: 2007-08-19
  • スコア: 6.43/10 (9 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 田舎でシよう! 鳥取編 －ボクと妹たちの夏休み－
  • 英語名: Inaka de Shiyou! Tottori Hen -Boku to Imouto-tachi no Natsuyasumi-

あらすじ

“Onii-chan is coming back—”

The big brother that left home years ago comes back into his hometown for the summer vacation.

At the time they had to part with their big brother, his young sisters cried, since they couldn’t meet him anymore.

After that they grew up themself.
